name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for car customization. Growing up in a small town near Poznan, he spent countless hours tinkering with his father's old Polski Fiat, learning the intricacies of bodywork and paint application. He honed his skills through apprenticeships at local garages, eventually specializing in custom paint jobs and restoration projects.

Driven by a desire to work at the highest level, Krzysztof joined Hot Racing Team five years ago. He approaches his work with a meticulous eye for detail, ensuring that every car leaving the paint shop meets the team's exacting standards. Known for his adaptability, he can seamlessly switch between intricate custom designs and the demands of race-day repairs, always delivering flawless results under pressure. Krzysztof's commitment to quality and his ability to quickly adapt to changing circumstances makes him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring the cars look their best on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always has a piece of Polish candy in his pocket.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, regardless of how busy he is.
